notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: The claw is designed, not converted, so this part has no reference mesh and only its revised render is shown. Its dimensions are claw_params.scad's, whose THE FLIP paragraph gives why one gear, drawn the same way up, serves both pivots. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the render is its output.
